seo.title: About Us | Irwell Plumbing & Heating, Salford
seo.description: Family-run since 2012. Meet Dave and Ryan Hughes, Gas Safe heating engineers serving Salford, Manchester, Trafford and Bury.

about.heading: Family run, Salford through and through
about.intro: Two Gas Safe engineers, one van and a simple idea: do the job right and treat every home like our own.
story: Dave Hughes started Irwell Plumbing & Heating in 2012 after ten years as an engineer with British Gas. He wanted to give people the kind of service he'd want himself: honest advice, a fair price and work done properly the first time.
In 2019 his son Ryan joined the business as a heating engineer. Today we're still a small family team, and we still answer our own phones.
We look after homeowners and landlords across Salford, Manchester, Trafford and Bury, and many local letting agents trust us with their landlord gas safety certificates.
